rules.name: legacy-position-default-b-check
rules.sql: SELECT 'settle_rba' AS cache_table, a.portfolio, a.subportfolio, SUBSTRING_INDEX(a.trade_id, '-', -1) AS trade_group, a.h_p AS cache_h_p, b.h_p AS mapped_h_p, COUNT(*) AS row_count FROM dbsystemuat.helper_settle_p_and_g_position_cache_table_rba a LEFT JOIN dbsystemuat.pos_1211_port_trader_mapping_table b ON a.portfolio = b.portfolio AND a.subportfolio = b.subportfolio AND SUBSTRING_INDEX(a.trade_id, '-', -1) = b.`group` GROUP BY a.portfolio, a.subportfolio, SUBSTRING_INDEX(a.trade_id, '-', -1), a.h_p, b.h_p UNION ALL SELECT 'settle_rbc', a.portfolio, a.subportfolio, SUBSTRING_INDEX(a.trade_id, '-', -1), a.h_p, b.h_p, COUNT(*) FROM dbsystemuat.helper_settle_p_and_g_position_cache_table_rbc a LEFT JOIN dbsystemuat.pos_1211_port_trader_mapping_table b ON a.portfolio = b.portfolio AND a.subportfolio = b.subportfolio AND SUBSTRING_INDEX(a.trade_id, '-', -1) = b.`group` GROUP BY a.portfolio, a.subportfolio, SUBSTRING_INDEX(a.trade_id, '-', -1), a.h_p, b.h_p UNION ALL SELECT 'actual_rba', a.portfolio, a.subportfolio, SUBSTRING_INDEX(a.trade_id, '-', -1), a.h_p, b.h_p, COUNT(*) FROM dbsystemuat.helper_settle_p_and_g_actual_position_cache_table_rba a LEFT JOIN dbsystemuat.pos_1211_port_trader_mapping_table b ON a.portfolio = b.portfolio AND a.subportfolio = b.subportfolio AND SUBSTRING_INDEX(a.trade_id, '-', -1) = b.`group` GROUP BY a.portfolio, a.subportfolio, SUBSTRING_INDEX(a.trade_id, '-', -1), a.h_p, b.h_p UNION ALL SELECT 'actual_rbc', a.portfolio, a.subportfolio, SUBSTRING_INDEX(a.trade_id, '-', -1), a.h_p, b.h_p, COUNT(*) FROM dbsystemuat.helper_settle_p_and_g_actual_position_cache_table_rbc a LEFT JOIN dbsystemuat.pos_1211_port_trader_mapping_table b ON a.portfolio = b.portfolio AND a.subportfolio = b.subportfolio AND SUBSTRING_INDEX(a.trade_id, '-', -1) = b.`group` GROUP BY a.portfolio, a.subportfolio, SUBSTRING_INDEX(a.trade_id, '-', -1), a.h_p, b.h_p

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(x.total_rows), 0) AS cache_rows, COALESCE(SUM(x.unmapped_rows), 0) AS unmapped_rows, COALESCE(SUM(x.unmapped_not_b), 0) AS unmapped_not_b FROM ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_rows, SUM(b.h_p IS NULL) AS unmapped_rows, SUM(b.h_p IS NULL AND (a.h_p IS NULL OR a.h_p <> 'B')) AS unmapped_not_b FROM dbsystemuat.helper_settle_p_and_g_position_cache_table_rba a LEFT JOIN dbsystemuat.pos_1211_port_trader_mapping_table b ON a.portfolio = b.portfolio AND a.subportfolio = b.subportfolio AND SUBSTRING_INDEX(a.trade_id, '-', -1) = b.`group` UNION ALL SELECT COUNT(*), SUM(b.h_p IS NULL), SUM(b.h_p IS NULL AND (a.h_p IS NULL OR a.h_p <> 'B')) FROM dbsystemuat.helper_settle_p_and_g_position_cache_table_rbc a LEFT JOIN dbsystemuat.pos_1211_port_trader_mapping_table b ON a.portfolio = b.portfolio AND a.subportfolio = b.subportfolio AND SUBSTRING_INDEX(a.trade_id, '-', -1) = b.`group` UNION ALL SELECT COUNT(*), SUM(b.h_p IS NULL), SUM(b.h_p IS NULL AND (a.h_p IS NULL OR a.h_p <> 'B')) FROM dbsystemuat.helper_settle_p_and_g_actual_position_cache_table_rba a LEFT JOIN dbsystemuat.pos_1211_port_trader_mapping_table b ON a.portfolio = b.portfolio AND a.subportfolio = b.subportfolio AND SUBSTRING_INDEX(a.trade_id, '-', -1) = b.`group` UNION ALL SELECT COUNT(*), SUM(b.h_p IS NULL), SUM(b.h_p IS NULL AND (a.h_p IS NULL OR a.h_p <> 'B')) FROM dbsystemuat.helper_settle_p_and_g_actual_position_cache_table_rbc a LEFT JOIN dbsystemuat.pos_1211_port_trader_mapping_table b ON a.portfolio = b.portfolio AND a.subportfolio = b.subportfolio AND SUBSTRING_INDEX(a.trade_id, '-', -1) = b.`group` ) x

expect.reason: the legacy cache tables must hold rows, otherwise nothing can be proved
some legacy rows have no mapping, otherwise the default B is not exercised
legacy leaves h_p = B on every row without a mapping, so the new default B matches
